messages:
Marta: Cutting RC image rwinf/release:2026.3.0-rc1 now. Change window 02:00-03:30 UTC. Requesting sigprod signoff + pin approval. Release notes: runtime KV-cache perf tweak, fix streaming termination edge-case, add abort_on_rate_limit flag.

deploy-bot: CI status: unit ✅ integration ✅ e2e flaky tests skipped. Artifact signature verified. To run staging smoke: `/deploy smoke staging rwinf/release:2026.3.0-rc1`.

Nicole: kicked off staging smoke now, will watch core paths and streaming for ~20m.

Sam: FYI please add model_server pin in release control: `pin: model_server=v4-compiled`. Also confirm rollout policy and canary steps in the rollout matrix.

Vikram: SRE acked. Rollback plan in PR 412: immediate revert to v2026.2.9 ASG and circuit-breaker on higher error. Triggers: 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m or p95 latency +150% over baseline. Ops automation ready.

Nicole: staging smoke finished — all core flows pass. Logs: `no errors in 10m`, median latency 22ms, streaming session handoffs OK.

Marta: Great. Laura (product) — need signoff on behavior change surface (streaming termination fix).

Laura: Quick look — no user-visible changes except more deterministic streaming finish. +1 from product. :thumbsup:

ops_oncall: Oncall OK with window. I'll monitor first 30m after promotion. Tag me on any surge or Canary anomalies.

Marta: Calling for sigprod: please reply with +1 to approve promotion to prod.

Sam: +1 — config & pin checked.

Vikram: +1 SRE. Rollback tested in staging automation.

Nicole: +1 QA. Smoke and basic perf green.

Laura: +1 PM.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled and initiated at 1847501280. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Health checks: 5xx rate, p95 latency, token throughput.

deploy-bot: Canary 10% deployed — health ok. metrics: 5xx=0.02%, p95=150ms, token/sec stable.

Marta: advancing to 50% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary 50% success — p95=170ms, 5xx=0.03%, no consumer errors reported.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete. Prod image: rwinf/release:2026.3.0-rc1.

deploy-bot: Kicking off post-release jobs: perf-eval + regression-check. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

Marta: Thanks all — pin retained for 24h. If any regression appears, we will execute rollback plan. Closing thread.
